entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: Defensive: TraceQL admits only OpExists / OpNotExists / OpNot unary operators, all handled above, so the unsupported-operator branch is unreachable from a parseable query.

guard: past exhaustive switch u.Op over [case traceql.OpExists, traceql.OpNotExists; case traceql.OpNot; case traceql.OpSub]
